gemini.rationale: The transaction was a direct stock purchase of 100% of the equity of two operating companies (NPS and GES) by a blank check company (NESR). The products (T4), processes (T5), and organizations (T6) of both targets were acquired whole and intact as going concerns, with no documented structural mismatch or carve-out friction at closing.

grok.rationale: gap_45=0 because the slice states the customer-facing product lines of both NPS and GES, together with their operations, were the businesses acquired via 100% equity stock purchases, so product and process crossed together; NESR had no pre-closing active business. gap_56=0 because the same whole-company equity acquisitions transferred the targets as going concerns, with pre-existing target executive employment agreements disclosed as continuing arrangements at closing alongside the operations, and no structural product/process-vs-people mismatch is documented in the closing instruments.

openai.rationale: The Product/asset line states that NPS’s and GES’s customer-facing oilfield-service product lines and operations were acquired together through purchases of 100% of their equity, so no product-versus-process mismatch is documented at closing. The People/organization line states that target-level executive employment arrangements continued, while the governance and executive-leadership lines document an expanded board, continuation of NESR’s CEO, and appointment of a new CFO; thus the processes were accompanied by an aligned operating organization rather than transferred without it.
